description: Header file defining utility structures and functions for generating ninja build commands related to GN build system, including writers for defines, frameworks, weak libraries, includes, and functions for handling precompiled headers.

classes.name: DefineWriter
classes.description: Utility for writing -D defines into ninja commands.

classes.name: FrameworkDirsWriter
classes.description: Utility for writing framework directory flags.

classes.name: WeakLibrariesWriter
classes.description: Utility for writing weak library flags.

classes.name: IncludeWriter
classes.description: Utility for writing include directory flags.

methods.name: WriteOneFlag
methods.description: Writes a build flag for a target, considering precompiled headers and tool-specific flags.

methods.name: GetPCHOutputFiles
methods.description: Retrieves output files for precompiled headers for a target.

methods.name: GetGCCPCHOutputExtension
methods.description: Returns the file extension for GCC precompiled headers.

methods.name: GetWindowsPCHObjectExtension
methods.description: Returns the object file extension for Windows precompiled headers.
